slo_title: Define the concept of domain in protection

mcq.q: In the protection ring model, Ring 0 generally refers to:
Which of these best defines a domain of protection ?

options.A: The set of all files in the system
options.B: A set of objects and the types of operations allowed on them
options.C: The memory allocated to a process

mcq.answer_text: A set of objects and the types of operations allowed on them

mcq.q: Which of the following is not a goal of protection in an operating system?

options.A: To prevent misuse of system resources
options.C: To ensure controlled access to system resources

mcq.q: The principle of least privilege in protection means

options.B: Giving processes only necessary privileges to perform tasks

mcq.answer_text: Giving processes only necessary privileges to perform tasks

mcq.q: The protection ring model organizes system privileges

options.B: In a linear hierarchy with the outermost ring having highest privilege
options.C: In concentric layers with innermost ring having highest privilege

mcq.answer_text: In concentric layers with innermost ring having highest privilege

sq.q: What is the main goal of protection in an operating system?
answer: The main goal is to ensure controlled and secure access to system resources by preventing unauthorized use or misuse.

sq.q: Define a protection domain with an example.
answer: A protection domain is a set of objects together with the operations allowed on them. For example, a user process that can read a file but cannot write to it forms a protection domain.
